messages:
Nora: Heads-up: onboarding queue spiked overnight, saw long wait times for heavy benches. linking notes in RFC thread.
Felix: Yep, noticed the same. Seems the prober fires many long-seqlen shards in parallel for large models.
Sam: Can we add a per-model shaping policy that caps concurrent heavy benches and guarantees minimal golden coverage?
Priya: I like cap + guarantee. Suggest two lanes: "safety" (guaranteed, low-rate) and "deep" (opportunistic). Intake returns lane and ETA.
Nora: Also need a backoff driven by runtime SLOs. If cluster_p95 > target, reduce deep lane by 50% every minute until stable.
Felix: Agree. We should sign bench tickets so workers can't spoof lane. Private deploys use their own signing key.
Sam: What about diversity? Ensure safety lane cycles across prompt buckets round-robin so we don't miss prompt families.
Priya: Add preemption: failed safety bench with high delta can preempt next deep bench. Limit preemptions per-hour per-model to avoid starvation.
infra-bot: scheduled bench TKT-172050-11 model:xl-large lane:safety eta:1720502600 :gear:
Nora: Action items: Felix will prototype ticket signing, Sam will add shape controller to intake, Priya will draft preemption limits and metrics. We'll canary next week.
